text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
It's flower-viewing, flower-viewing time! 
Let's go flower-viewing, woohoo!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Underneath the spring cherry blossom 
trees— The Umamusume made their way to 
school.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Cherry blossoms...! My flower... My most 
beloved flower!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
How poetic~ Ah, is it already that time of 
year~?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
We can enjoy cherry blossom viewing on our 
way to and from school. What a stroke of 
good fortune just for the two of us.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you guys. How do you all spend the 
cherry blossom season?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
How I spend my time? For me~ I often enjoy 
myself over a cup of tea. A single cherry 
blossom petal floating gently into the 
teacup~

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: "This is—what I'll do. Seiya—ha!!"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
—Straight punch training. Striking right 
at the tip of the fist, without letting 
the wind pressure blow the cherry blossom 
petals away.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I just often find myself looking up!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I want to bloom like this someday. I'm 
Sakura, but I haven't truly become a 
cherry blossom yet.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Someday... That's right, we are still 
cherry blossoms yet to bloom. All so that 
we may one day bloom with pride."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"So, Inari One-senpai... how do you like 
to appreciate the cherry blossoms?"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
*Munch, munch, munch*, not looking. Food's 
way more important than that!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I-I see. Dumplings over flowers, huh...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Inari One-san...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
W-What's up?! If I offended you or 
something...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Give me one, pleeeease!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Words of pure, heartfelt innocence echoed 
along the row of cherry blossom trees.
